prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning (tanning beds) or a spray tan? That will change which salons are best.

I can’t look up live ratings from here, but I can help you find the best salon in Pleasanton and give a checklist of what to look for. Quick advice:

How to find the best salon
- Search Google Maps, Yelp and Nextdoor for “tanning salon Pleasanton, CA” and sort by rating and recent reviews.
- Check each salon’s website or Instagram for photos of the facility and equipment and for the spray-tan brands they use (Mystic, VersaSpa, etc.).
- Read the most recent reviews (last 6–12 months) and watch for comments about cleanliness, helpful staff, consistency and results.

Questions to ask the salon (phone or in person)
- Do you offer spray tanning, UV tanning beds, or both? What brands/models do you use?
- Are spray tans applied by a technician or automated? Do you use Mystic/Versa/Vita?
- How do you sanitize beds and booths between clients?
- Do your techs have certifications/training? Can I see before/after photos or client references?
- Do you do a patch test for spray tans or custom blending for fair skin?
- What are pricing, package and cancellation policies?
- Do you provide eye protection and guidelines for safe scheduling to avoid overexposure?

Safety reminders
- UV tanning increases skin-cancer risk; if you choose UV beds, follow recommended session limits and protect sensitive areas.
- Spray tans or self-tanning products (St. Tropez, Bondi Sands) are much safer for getting a bronzed look.
- If you have fair skin, a history of skin cancer, or take photosensitizing meds, avoid UV tanning and consult your doctor.

If you want, tell me whether you want spray or UV tanning and I’ll suggest the types of places to look for in Pleasanton and draft a short message you can use to contact salons. If you want, give me three salon names you found and I’ll help compare them.
